The 0.219-second R3 rebind made no inference: it preserves the R1 responses, response IDs, timings and prompt counts byte-for-byte through the R2 and R3 retained samples. The approved claim is limited to exact target-code retrieval under this frozen synthetic construct. The decoys are highly regular: the instruction explicitly excludes numbered labels, all decoy codes end D01 through D31, and the target is the only code ending in an S, M or E position suffix. These shortcuts make the panel useful as a bounded regression but not evidence for arbitrary interference resistance, natural long-context reasoning, production RAG quality, latency ranking or unseen decoy families.
